entries.d1a919c8b48b95d4: The medium-term management plan aims for growth in each category: golf, running, football (soccer), indoor sports and sports style, and promotes product development and marketing tailored to the characteristics of each region. It will also strengthen investment to expand the DTC (direct-to-consumer) area through opening directly operated stores and improving e-commerce convenience, and to expand business in Southeast Asia, India and South America, which are growth markets. It is also working to apply knowledge and technology cultivated in sports to other fields such as work apparel, and has set a target of ¥330 billion in revenue for fiscal 2028.
